about: The commemoration of the dead in the Canon. The priest prays for God's servants and handmaids who have gone before with the sign of faith and rest in peace, asking for them and for all who rest in Christ a place of refreshment, light, and peace.

s01.translation: Remember also, Lord, Your servants and handmaids who have gone before us with the sign of faith and rest in the sleep of peace.

s02.narrative: The priest joins his hands and prays a while in silence for those dead he means to remember, then spreads his hands and goes on.

s03.translation: Grant them, O Lord, we pray, and all who sleep in Christ, a place of refreshment, light and peace.

s04.narrative: The priest joins his hands and bows his head.

s05.translation: Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

w011.function: Ablative after “cum” (w010): “with the sign of faith”. CCC 1274 relates the phrase to baptismal faith kept until death.

w024.function: A participle used as a noun in the dative plural.

w026.function: A genitive dependent on “locum” (w025), coordinated with “lucis” (w027) and “pacis” (w029).

w032.function: First-person plural present of a deponent verb.
